claim: A telling `service-watching` writes waits as a page until a seat holding that name reads it, so a persona opening her first seat in days takes every telling written since at once, each one true when it was written and none of them new.

evidence:
Ember's seat took nine tellings between 03:54:56 and 03:55:58 on 2026-09-14. They were written on nine different days and hours: `383ab1c70d5` on 09-08 at 14:51:02, `7b582336183` on 09-11 at 13:55:09, `4c8e287df64` on 09-11 at 18:39:50, `b3e588da7f8` on 09-12 at 04:39:07, `ae8fcebc9a5` on 09-12 at 06:13:14, `886fd8a2b6a` on 09-12 at 06:30:12, `fb073e24029` on 09-12 at 12:58:04, `02b8bfbba0c` on 09-13 at 09:03:07 and `b423b66af96` on 09-13 at 15:34:55. Eight named `ttc-client` and one named `temper-watcher`.

Every one of the nine was true when it was written. `02b8bfbba0c` says `ttc-client` was `deactivating`, and the journal has the unit failing at 09:03:02 and started again at 09:03:12, so the watcher sampled inside those ten seconds. `b423b66af96` says `inactive`, and the unit stopped at 15:24:00 and started again at 16:14:44, so it had been down fifty minutes. A telling is written from a live `systemctl --user show`, so none of these was a stale reading.

The asymmetry is the unit rather than the watcher. `ttc-client` states `restart: on-failure` with ten seconds of delay and `partOf: graphical-session.target`, and its journal for 09-12 alone holds stop and start pairs at 05:52, 06:00, 06:01, 06:03, 06:08, 06:10, 06:18, 06:19 and 06:29, most of them a second or two. `temper-watcher` restarts far less often. The watcher samples every sixty seconds with five seconds of jitter, so how often it catches a unit is how much of the day that unit spends not running.

The cooling did not hold them apart. `deciding` keeps a ledger entry only while a service reads broken, so a service that mends loses its `brokenSince` and its `toldAt`, and the next break is a first break owed a telling at once. Two of the nine are an hour and a half apart, inside the day the cooling states.

What carried them all to one minute is that nothing drained the inbox. A telling is a message page addressed by name, and `takeMessage` is what removes it; nothing removes a message written to a persona who is holding no seat. The oldest waited six days.

Every telling now states the moment it was seen and the moment systemd measured the unit entering the state it is in, so a telling read six days late reads as six days old. What remains is that they still arrive together, and that a persona holding no seat is told nothing until she opens one.
